# Graph operations · material

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### material.base

Read the resolved shared material settings and derive pixel and physical sampling extents.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `settings` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `width` | `pixelCount` | — | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Output | `height` | `pixelCount` | — | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Output | `samples` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `pixelPitchMm` | `vec2` | — | {"dimensions":2,"finite":true} |
| Output | `physicalSizeMm` | `vec2` | — | {"dimensions":2,"finite":true} |
| Output | `tiling` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `seed` | `number` | — | {"finite":true} |

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.base --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.layer

Layer typed material maps with shared UV placement, coverage and height dominance, and per-channel blend rules.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `base` | `materialChannels` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Input | `layer` | `materialChannels` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | Opacity, channel rules, UV transform, mask space and height dominance. · {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"opacity":{"type":"number","min":0,"max":1,"default":1},"defaultMode":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["blend","keep"]},"default":"blend"},"channels":{"type":"record"},"transform":{"type":"record"},"maskSpace":{"type":"string","constraints":{"choices":["layer","base"]},"default":"layer"},"height":{"type":"record"}} |
| Input | `mask` | `any` | `null` | Normalized grayscale coverage in layer or base UV space. |
| Output | `value` | `materialChannels` | — | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |

- Match UV sets and use typed images for blended maps. Existing maps keep their grids and encodings.
- A single transform places the layer. Tangent normals and UV flow vectors follow it.
- Height dominance compares equal-unit relief and gates every active map. Use material.replace to edit individual maps before layering.

Guides: [guide](../material-layering.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.layer --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.paint

Apply an editable stroke and layer session to native typed material maps.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `materialChannels` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Input | `session` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `masks` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `charts` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `flows` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `materialChannels` | — | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Output | `report` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

- A session affects only the channels it paints or explicitly converts.
- Blend color in linear light. Preserve native float height and flow samples and allow HDR color in a floating linear canvas.
- Paint in texel, top-left UV, world or rest space. Named masks, chart projections, and native flow maps can come from upstream nodes.

Guides: [guide](../material-channel-paint.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.paint --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.scanProcess

Register, de-light, repair and tile material scan maps on a shared surface grid.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `materialChannels` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} · {"align":{"type":"record","description":"Shared target dimensions, pitch, landmarks and channel overrides."},"repair":{"type":"record","description":"Repair radius, defect threshold and minimum evidence coverage."},"tile":{"type":"record","description":"Crop, repeat axes, seam bands and normal reconstruction mode."},"deLight":{"type":"record","description":"Correction strength and minimum calibrated irradiance."}} |
| Input | `defects` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `illumination` | `any` | `null` |  |
| Input | `validity` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `materialChannels` | — | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Output | `aligned` | `materialChannels` | — | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Output | `delit` | `materialChannels` | — | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Output | `repaired` | `materialChannels` | — | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Output | `repairedMask` | `grayImage` | — | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Output | `unresolved` | `grayImage` | — | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Output | `support` | `grayImage` | — | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Output | `report` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

- Use a typed material packet, optional per-map validity, a target-space defect mask and calibrated source-space illumination.
- Inspect registered, de-lit, repaired and tiled packets. Repair uses the same donor for all maps.
- A repeat crop needs complete or repaired evidence. The seam report measures the opposing edge mismatch for every map.

Guides: [guide](../scan-processing.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.scanProcess --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.smartMask

Generate and inspect a wear or environment mask from aligned geometry bakes and authored corrections.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `recipe` | `string` | Required |  |
| Input | `bakes` | `record` | Required | Named typed bakes for one UV grid. · {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `options` | `record` | `{}` | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `add` | `any` | `null` | Optional aligned unitless grayscale correction image. |
| Input | `remove` | `any` | `null` | Optional aligned unitless grayscale correction image. |
| Output | `value` | `grayImage` | — | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Output | `raw` | `grayImage` | — | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Output | `evidence` | `grayImage` | — | {"layout":"Typed unitless single-channel data or mask"} |
| Output | `report` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

- Choose edgeWear, dirt, dust, rust, leaks, slope, waterline or exposure.
- Supply aligned typed bake images and a coverage map. Inspect the evidence, generated mask, corrected mask and recipe report.
- Paint additions and protection separately. Leaks route downhill by baked position inside the supplied UV tile.

Guides: [guide](../smart-material-masks.md)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.smartMask --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
